title: Localized pairing ofReal(∫φu div g) ≤ |Du|(U) + ∫|u||Dφ| (Simon 2.8 (4), C5(b))
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open, u ∈ L¹(ℝⁿ), φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ Lipschitz with 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1, compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ U, and g ∈ C_c(ℝⁿ, ℝⁿ) with Chapter02.IsLipschitzTestField g and compactlySupportedSupNorm g ≤ 1. Then in [0, ∞]: ofReal(∫ φ·u·div g) ≤ bvVariationOn u U + ∫⁻ ‖u‖ₑ‖Dφ‖ₑ (Dφ = fderiv ℝ φ, div g = Chapter02.euclideanDivergence ⇑g).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (u φ : Rn n → ℝ) (g : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Rn n) (Rn n)), IsOpen U → Integrable u volume → (∃ K, LipschitzWith K φ) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → Chapter02.IsLipschitzTestField g → Chapter02.compactlySupportedSupNorm g ≤ 1 → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, φ x * u x * Chapter02.euclideanDivergence (g : Rn n → Rn n) x) ≤ Chapter02.bvVariationOn u U + ∫⁻ x, ‖u x‖ₑ * ‖fderiv ℝ φ x‖ₑ
